Peanut butter & honey.

Everyday essentials. Thoughtfully considered.

Discover Toldit’s developing peanut butter and honey range: proposed jars, portion cups, honey spoon stirrers and a dual-pack concept.

Products remain in development. Final ingredients, specifications, packaging, pricing and availability are yet to be confirmed. We are not accepting orders through this website.

South Sudan at the source.

Our honey comes from Yambio in Western Equatoria State and Yei in Central Equatoria State, South Sudan. Our peanuts are grown in Lakes State and the Juba and Wau areas of South Sudan.

These origins are at the heart of the range we’re developing. Manufacturing and packing locations are not yet confirmed.

Questions, answered.

Where does Toldit honey come from?

Our honey comes from Yambio in Western Equatoria State and Yei in Central Equatoria State, South Sudan.

Where are Toldit peanuts grown?

Our peanuts are grown in Lakes State and the Juba and Wau areas of South Sudan.

Can I buy these products now?

These products are in development. Availability and launch dates have not been confirmed, and we are not accepting orders through this website.

Can retailers or distributors inquire?

Yes. Contact our team to discuss your interest. Supply arrangements, territories, prices and commercial terms remain unconfirmed.
